notes.title: Fixed Crash Bug: Italian, French, Polish, Turkish, Traditional Chinese version.
notes.content: Fixed game crash issue in Italian, French, Polish, Turkish, Traditional Chinese versions. Thank you to Melun for highlighting this issue.
